Elson; and in addition, some of the slower men—Jarvis, Snell, Willis, Seddon, Armstrong, and others. One hundred and sixty-three competitors actually started to the signal of our President over our usual seven miles course, and from the start Johnson (Enfield), Cooper (Woodford Green), Redman (Metro…
Stan Goold in his first race for us showed that he will be very useful. Boddington, Snell, Clark and Jarvis all put up creditable shows, as did also C.
R., was third; and it is to be hoped that he continues to improve as well as his brother has done. The Walk gave Frank Jarvis (575) his first Club prize; the minor places being filled by C.

Elson, Heather, Goold, Jarvis, Boddington, Snell Hamer, Spooner, Cornish, Joe Coleman, Earle, Urry, Clark, Pattenden, Willis, True and several others, some beginners, who are showing rapid improvement.
Boddington, Clark, Earle, and Jarvis, being second. Fifteen of the first 52 to finish the course were Belgrave Harriers, which is a splendid indication of good all-round strength.

Middle distance talent is almost in abundance so with challengers like Hampshire,Jarvis, Alan Mead, Hammond, Wiseman, Brown, Yeo, Redwood and Satchell not very far behind, David cannot afford to flag in his efforts.
…he recent Mitcham match, was on this occasion representing Raynes Park but did not look quite so happy this time, while Jarvis was running immeasurably better than on his previous outing.…

Derek Wade ran well on the first leg to record the good time of 8;4, and Yeo's 8:10 for an intermediate stage was equally noteworthy. Smith and Jarvis were our only two runners in the 'C' team, which consequently was unable to close in.

Hampshire, after a sequence of mile races, found the speed a little too great in the 880yds but still turned in a respectable 2:5.7 to finish second to Dollimore (SLH) 2:3.6. In fourth place was Jarvis (2:22.6).
Third in a personal best was Jarvis (5:2.0). Cocks was a comfortable winner of the 880 with 2:3.7, and later went out to take second spot in the quarter with 56.7.
